sources.title: Apollo 13 Mission Report
supports: Loss of service-module cryogenic oxygen caused the abort
The lunar module provided power and life support for return
A circumlunar return profile was used

sources.title: Mission Operations Report: Apollo 13
supports: Controllers and crew first sorted false indications from real failures
By 57:35 mission elapsed time the crew was entering the lunar module for communications and life support

sources.title: Dominated-option review
supports: Once command-module oxygen and fuel-cell loss was established, remaining in the command module was not a credible balanced option
The case is better modeled as progressive crisis decisions than one binary choice
